protocol.dataset: MuSiQue-Ans v1.0 public training subset, overlap-controlled selection: 140 measured / 30 previously observed warm-up
protocol.warmup: one fixed development query once per method; excluded from metrics
protocol.order: seeded shuffle of all query, method and repetition jobs
protocol.cache: RocksDB and OS caches retained; no result cache; no forced cold run
protocol.query_embeddings: frozen once and reused by every vector mode; no encoder inside DB
reported_metrics: source, candidate, graph and affinity work
protocol.scope_of_evidence: Predeclared comparison on new-to-this-evaluation public-training questions. Not the official hidden test set, proof of statistical independence, a default change, or agent efficacy evidence.

split_mapping.development: previously observed official training questions; warm-up only in the reserved comparison
split_mapping.test: new-to-this-evaluation public train subset; not official hidden test or guaranteed model-unseen data

protocol.category_weighting: Each measured query has equal weight: 80 two-hop, 40 three-hop, 20 four-hop; report categories separately.
protocol.inference_limits: Paired query bootstrap intervals are exploratory; no multiple-comparison correction, no power guarantee; declared overlap exclusions do not prove statistical independence.

source_provenance.judgments: grade 1 for original supporting paragraphs; other union-corpus documents unjudged
source_provenance.selection_verification: Complete deterministic selection replay against pinned official sources and all declared historical fixtures
source_provenance.selection_annotation_use: Answerability eligibility and support/answer overlap exclusions only; no retrieval scores or quality-based selection
selection_limits: Public data; not guaranteed absent from model training
Greedy strata and exclusions change the source distribution; not a uniform sample
Declared identity disjointness does not prove statistical independence
Unlisted historical fixtures cannot be excluded automatically
Shared distractors and semantically equivalent answers may remain

embedding_provenance.overlength: truncate right to 512 tokens including special tokens
